subject: width of the first column in ggpairs with axisLabels

messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: width of the first column in ggpairs with axisLabels
parts:
Hello, 

When showing the axes labels with ggpairs:

data(tips, package="reshape")
pm <- ggpairs(tips[,1:3], axisLabels="show")
print(pm)

then the width of the (gray aeras of the) plots in the first column is smaller than the width of the other columns. Do you know a way to get the same widths ?
